## Associated Issue
- Closes # (Replace with Issue Number, e.g. #12)

## Description of Changes
- Provide a brief summary of the logic implemented or regression fixed.

## Type of Change
- [ ] feat: A new feature inside backend / frontend components.
- [ ] fix: A bug fix targeting active views or logic state machines.
- [ ] refactor: Code changes that neither fix a bug nor add a feature.
- [ ] test: Adding missing automated unit test cases.

## Quality Gate Checklist
- [ ] My code compiles successfully locally without compilation warnings.
- [ ] All automated unit tests passed successfully (`npm run test:ci`).
- [ ] No default test credentials or sensitive database secrets are hardcoded.
- [ ] Code changes align perfectly with the `index.html` prototype specifications.
- [ ] Code structure strictly adheres to the 'com.tsmc.lims.[feature].[layer]' package naming convention.
